title: Transitions keep old content instead of a fallback

slides.say: You navigate to a new page that suspends. The whole page is replaced by a big spinner. Jarring.
Wrap the navigation in start transition. It tells React the update is not urgent.

slides.text: React keeps showing the already-revealed content until the new page is ready.
slides.say: Now React keeps the previous page on screen instead of hiding already revealed content with a fallback.

slides.text: Only already-visible content is protected; new nested boundaries still show fallbacks.
slides.say: It only avoids hiding content that is already visible. New nested boundaries can still show their own fallbacks.
